## Hard rules (every repo)

- Never commit secrets, `.env` files, keystores, tokens, or credentials.
- No git mutations (commit/push/reset/rebase) unless explicitly asked in-session.
- Models/cost: Sonnet 5 default and floor; 1–2 subagents max; ask before 3+ agent fan-outs. Details: `feedback-cost-control.md`.
- gh-cloud-01 is shared prod — `free -h` before heavy builds there; spot-check systemd services after.
- Production writes: back up first, wrap multi-step DB writes in a transaction, then report what was applied.
